decision_conditions: The roof lights hereby permitted shall be conservation style roof lights and shall be flush to their host roof slope. The development shall be retained in that form thereafter unless otherwise approved in writing by the local planning authority.
The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no window(s)/door(s), other than those shown on the approved plans shall be installed in the flank elevations of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), the windows and doors shown on the flank elevations of the development herby permitted must be:

(a) obscure-glazed; and

(b) non-opening unless the parts of the window which can be opened are more than 1.7 metres above the floor of the room in which the window is installed. 

The windows/doors installed on flank elevations must be retained as such in perpetuity.

The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extensions and alterations hereby permitted shall match those used in the host dwellinghouse, unless otherwise approved in writing by the local planning authority.

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 (or any order revoking or re-enacting that order with or without modification), the flat roof sections of the development herby permitted must not be used as an outdoor balcony, terrace or similar outdoor amenity space and the development must be retained as such in perpetuity.

The outbuilding hereby permitted shall not be occupied, used at any time as a separate residential unit or place of primary living accommodation and shall remain incidental to the use to the host dwellinghouse unless otherwise approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

<p>The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and reports: Drawing numbers PR24-077a, PR24-077b,&nbsp;PR24-077c,&nbsp;PR24-077d,&nbsp;PR24-077e,&nbsp;PR24-077g, PR24-077h (Proposed Outhouse), PR24-077h (Site Location Map); Drawing number PR24-DP-077a (Drainage Plan); Drawing number&nbsp;PR24-FDS-077a (Flood Displacement Storage); Flood Risk Assessment dated 25 June 2025; Heritage Statement prepared by Cedar Planning [not dated].&nbsp;</p>
description: Two storey side to rear extension, Single storey rear extension, Alterations to roof to raise ridge height and form rear dormer,  Roof lights in side roof slopes,  External alterations, Single storey detached outbuilding at rear for use as gym/Storage (Demolition of rear conservatory)
